verdict.rationale: Segment's docs say Audiences built from events, traits and computed traits can be synced to hundreds of Destinations, and that Engage is 'powered by real-time data' for activating Audiences. Nothing in the pack documents continuous sync cadence, users entering and exiting audiences in near-real-time, or ad-platform audience destinations specifically. missing for 10: documented continuous/streaming audience sync, near-real-time membership entry/exit behavior, named ad-platform audience destinations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, audiences sync to ad platforms and engagement tools continuously, with membership entering and exiting in near-real-time

citations.quote: You can build Audiences from core tracking events, traits, and computed traits. You can then sync Audiences to hundreds of Destinations
Powered by real-time data, Twilio Engage is a customizable personalization platform with which you can build, enrich, and activate Audiences.
Audiences let you group users or accounts based on event behavior and traits that Segment tracks.
